description.en: Adds two mid-turn interjection commands to a running DSH session: /say queues a message to the next step boundary without interrupting the step, and /cut aborts the current step and writes a structured recovery card describing what was in flight.
description.zh: 给正在跑的 DSH 会话加两条中途插话命令：/say 把消息无损地插到下一个步骤边界、不打断当前步骤；/cut 中止当前步骤，并写出结构化恢复卡记录当时在做什么。
